messages:
lauren: Heads up — AWS Marketplace asked for a consolidated evidence bundle for the ACME listing: SOC2 report (or attestation letter), the most recent pen-test report + remediation tracker, the completed SI/vendor questionnaire, and any HSM/KMS attestation. They want it by Thursday EOD. Can we assemble?

ravi: I can own the pen-test artifacts. Which exact files do they want? scope doc, raw report, remediation spreadsheet, attestation?

lauren: All of the above. Final report should be redacted for PII. We should also include a short attestation from security confirming redaction.

sam_security: Quick reminder — redaction checklist required: remove tester names, client-side credentials, customer PII. Use the redaction script in Ops playbook and attach redaction log. Also note any screenshots that expose internal hostnames must be blurred. :eyes:

adam_pm: Question on delivery — do we upload individual presigned links to the AWS listing portal or provide a single ZIP with manifest? AWS partner team can accept either, but manifest + checksums makes review faster.

michelle_ops: Ops prefers upload to our evidence bucket and then provide presigned URLs. Suggested path: `s3://marketplace-evidence/redwood/acme-2026-03-25/`. Presign expiry = 72h (259200s).

lauren: Suggested naming convention (please follow): `acme-2026-03-25/` folder with files: `acme-soc2-report.pdf.redacted`, `acme-pen-report.pdf.redacted`, `acme-pen-remediations.xlsx`, `acme-si-questionnaire.xlsx`, `acme-hsm-attestation.pdf`, plus `acme-manifest.json`.

ravi: I'll prepare: `pen-scope.pdf`, `pen-report.pdf` -> will run redaction and produce `acme-pen-report.pdf.redacted`. I'll also generate a remediation sheet `acme-pen-remediations.xlsx`.

ravi: Manifest preview (will include checksums):
```json
{"bundle":"acme-2026-03-25","files":[{"name":"acme-soc2-report.pdf.redacted","sha256":"<sha256>"},{"name":"acme-pen-report.pdf.redacted","sha256":"<sha256>"},{"name":"acme-pen-remediations.xlsx","sha256":"<sha256>"},{"name":"acme-si-questionnaire.xlsx","sha256":"<sha256>"},{"name":"acme-hsm-attestation.pdf","sha256":"<sha256>"}],"owner":"ravi","contact":"sam_security@redwood.com"}
```

michelle_ops: Presign command example: 
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/redwood/acme-2026-03-25/acme-pen-report.pdf.redacted --expires-in 259200
```

sam_security: Also need an internal evidence note: retention TTL = 365 days for marketplace artifacts, redaction log attached, redaction approver (me). Add a short security statement file `security-redaction-attestation.txt` that we can include in the bundle.

aws_partner_john: For AWS review we prefer: manifest with filenames + sha256s, a short cover letter (SOC attestation OK if full SOC is restricted), and presigned links. If SOC.pdf is under NDA, the attestation + service description + control summary is acceptable. Also confirm a single contact for security follow-up.

adam_pm: I'll compile the cover letter and compute checksums. Can someone run `sha256sum` and paste results?

ravi: I'll run checksums and paste into the manifest after redaction.

partners-bot: Upload note: new files uploaded to `s3://marketplace-evidence/redwood/acme-2026-03-25/` by michelle_ops at 2026-03-25T08:42Z (simulated). Please generate presigned URLs and notify AWS partner. :white_check_mark:

lauren: Action items & deadlines: 
- ravi: pen artifacts + checksums — Wed 12:00
- sam_security: redaction + attestation file — Wed 17:00
- michelle_ops: upload + presign links — Thu 09:00
- adam_pm: manifest + cover letter + ZIP (optional) — Thu 12:00
Please add your calendar blocks. I'll follow up in morning.

sam_security: One more: include contact `security@redwood.com` and Sam direct for any follow-ups. Also include the pen-test scope statement in plain text for reviewers.

lauren: Noted. michelle_ops — once you have presigned links, paste them here and I'll forward to AWS partner.

michelle_ops: Will do. Also adding retention metadata to object tags: `x-evidence-ttl=365d`, `x-partner=aws-marketplace`, `x-listing=acme`.

lauren: Great. Thanks everyone — big priority this week. Ping me if blockers.

aws_partner_john: Thanks — we'll confirm receipt after review. If anything is redacted that prevents assessment we'll request an escalation path (we may ask for a scoped secure view).

lauren: Copy that. I'll include escalation instructions in the cover letter.

(End of thread)
